ranges.title: Engagement ranges
ranges.onTitle: Shells round the units showing how far their weapons reach - least, best and most range - by vehicle and weaponry, cut where the unit cannot see.
ranges.unitsTitle: Selected: the followed, selected, target and measured units. Their side: every unit on a selected unit's side. All: every unit, nearest the camera first.
ranges.sensorsTitle: What the unit's radars, infrared search, laser rangefinders and designators, targeting pods, sonar and warning receivers cover: the sector they search about its nose and how far, cut by the line of sight. A radar the recording has on is drawn as recorded.
ranges.sensorNote: Radars: the solid shell is the reach for the reference target, the dashed one for a target with a tenth of its radar cross-section, the dotted one for a hundredth.
ranges.viewTitle: What the unit sees: its game's field of view from its eyes along where it looks, narrower while it aims or looks through a sight where the data says so, as far as the visual range, cut by the line of sight.
ranges.styleTitle: Glass: faint faces with bright rims. Lines: rings of elevation and meridians only. The edges where a shell is cut are always drawn.
ranges.losTitle: Each shell ends where terrain or buildings block the unit's view, with a bright edge there. Indirect fire (artillery, torpedoes) is not cut.
ranges.groundTitle: The ground the unit sees within reach is tinted in its colour: brighter inside the best range, with rings at the least, best and most range.
ranges.legend: Inner shells show through the outer ones. Each weapon has its own shade of the unit's side colour.
ranges.reading: Reading the weapons named in the data…
ranges.none: No weapons known for the units shown.
ranges.selectHint: Select or follow a unit to see its ranges.
ranges.estimateNote: Least – best – most range. * an estimate, not a figure from the game or a publication. Hover a weapon for its source.
ranges.game: Figures for {game} where known, else general ones.
ranges.recording.olderConverter: No {columns} column: this file was converted before heat3d-wt-replay wrote it (its build of 2026-11-17). Convert the replay again to get it.
